name: current-base-eventbus-change-event-header-fields
notes: Wave26 current-base eventbus lane: EventBus.ChangeEventHeader is constructible locally and the Summer '26 docs inventory documents writable get/set properties for changeorigin, changetype, commitnumber, committimestamp, commituser, difffields, entityname, nulledfields, recordids, sequencenumber, and transactionkey. changedfields is intentionally excluded because its documented signature is not an explicit {get; set;} property, so assignment is not yet dual-proven.
